entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these useless shoes I bought months ago. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-8675309. And you're damn right I'm not happy. I bought these expensive cycling shoes and they are complete garbage. I want a full refund, and I want it now!
I understand your frustration. To make sure I'm logging this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I don't care what you call it! I've tried adjusting the cleats a hundred times and every single ride, all I get are painful blisters. They're worthless! If I don't get my money back, I'm lighting you up on every review site I can find. Get me your manager!
I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. Let me just pull up your order details here... one moment... Okay, I see the order was delivered 76 days ago.
So what? Are you going to tell me it's too late? Because I swear...
Not at all, sir. I was just confirming the date. According to our VeloFit policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh. Really? So you're just going to approve it?

Yes, of course. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label as we speak. Just box up the shoes, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued back to your original payment method. The email should be in your inbox now.
Wow. Okay. Well... that's... that's actually great. Thank you. Sorry for getting so worked up.
It's no problem at all, I understand. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
